audit.args:
{'code': "
from qgis.PyQt.QtWidgets import QAction
mw = iface.mainWindow()
a = None
prev = None
for x in mw.findChildren(QAction):
    if x.objectName() == 'mActionTextAnnotationinRectangle':
        a = x
    elif x.objectName() == 'mActionTextAnnotationalongLine':
        prev = x
before = a.isChecked()
a.trigger()
canvas = iface.mapCanvas()
tool = canvas.mapTool()
result = {'before_checked': before, 'after_checked': a.isChecked(),
          'textline_action_now': prev.isChecked() if prev else None,
          'active_map_tool': type(tool).__name__ if tool else None,
          'tool_name': tool.toolName() if tool and hasattr(tool, 'toolName') else None,
          'capture_mode': int(tool.mode()) if tool and hasattr(tool, 'mode') else None}
"}
